description: Port of Ruff's F505 (percent-format-missing-argument): a valid `%`-format string without positional placeholders applied to a dict display without `**`, all of whose keys are string literals, that passes no value for some `%(key)` placeholder. `formatArgs` reads the format string left of `%` (a str literal with no f/t/b prefix, implicit concatenations joined, escapes decoded, parentheses transparent) with the `percentFormat` grammar (a port of ruff_python_literal's cformat parser), and the right operand as Ruff's strings.rs does.

violation.message: `%`-format string is missing argument(s) for placeholder(s)
